[[File:Spacers_chest.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A spacer's chest covered with holo-stickers.]]
'''Holo-stickers''', or '''holostickers''', were adhesive labels. They were often attached to [[Spacer's chest]]s to mark where [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] had traveled, or used in political campaigns. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Drextar Pym]] was known to use them.
